segments.oily: Numerous reviewers with oily skin report the gel controls shine and sebum through the day without feeling greasy, and several say it stopped the rebound oiliness they got from other moisturizers.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are split: some find it too light and drying, leaving skin tight, flaky or 'like a scab', while others (often pairing it with a heavier cream) find it adequately hydrating.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers largely say it balances oil on the T-zone while keeping the rest of the face comfortable, though a few found it drying around the mouth or not moisturizing enough.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive and reactive/rosacea-prone reviewers mostly tolerate it well with no breakouts, but a couple report burning, redness, or needing to build up tolerance slowly.
segments.mature: One mature-skin (69) reviewer with combination skin reports a non-heavy, non-sticky formula that left her skin looking glowing and healthy.
segments.normal: Reviewers describing normal-to-oily skin say it is lightweight yet moisturizing enough and sits well under makeup.

concerns.aging: The single mature-skin reviewer reports improved glow and healthy-looking skin, with no negative aging-specific comments in this set.
concerns.dehydration: Accounts diverge sharply: many say it hydrates well and leaves skin plump and dewy, while a notable group (including several 1-3 star reviews) say it dried their skin out, sometimes severely, and needed pairing with a heavier moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with oily/cystic acne reports reduced redness over time; another reviewer experienced burning followed by visible redness on first use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer credits it with strengthening and healthier-feeling skin barrier over time; another combines it with an azelaic acid product specifically to support barrier repair.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report fading of hyperpigmentation, dark spots, and acne scars after weeks of use, though one dry-skin reviewer says it only helps 'a little' with spots.
concerns.blemishes: Most acne-prone reviewers report no new breakouts and some improvement in active acne and scarring; one reviewer with 'really bad' cystic acne says it calms breakouts only somewhat, and one reviewer stopped use after developing tiny bumps.
concerns.oiliness: The majority of oily-skin reviewers report a clear reduction in shine and sebum production over time, with several calling it the first product that controls oil without drying them out.
